SS-KNOWLEDGE.Purpose: Define the FLI knowledge model: architectural contract nodes, tier decomposition, statement ownership, and verification linkage.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Tier model P/S/SS/M and Verification plane V.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Node identity, canonical `.frostline/graph/` catalog layout, role-to-parent mapping.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Authoring procedure guidance (owned by the frostline-graph skill; project-local authoring skills live in `.agents/skills/`).

Principles.PRIN-001: Every graph node is exactly one XML file; the root tag equals the node's unique identifier.
Principles.PRIN-002: Tiers are fixed and typed: Project, System, Subsystem, Module, Verification; no emergent ontology levels.
Principles.PRIN-003: Hierarchy direction: M -> SS -> S -> P; the verification plane mirrors architecture (V-M/V-SS/V-S/V-P).
Principles.PRIN-004: Implementation source layout, imports, calls, and dependencies are evidence and navigation, never parent authority.
Principles.PRIN-005: Multiple parents only when the child genuinely belongs to multiple superior nodes.

Requirements.REQ-001: Role mapping: implementation source (`src/`) parents point at `M-*`; test suites (`tests/`) parents point at `V-*`; verification nodes parent their verified target node; architectural nodes parent their superior node.
Requirements.REQ-002: Tier field matrix is authoritative: Project = Purpose, Scope, Principles, Technology, Codemap; System/Subsystem = Purpose, Scope, Principles, Requirements, Codemap; Module = Purpose, Scope, Requirements, Contract, Codemap; Verification = Command, TestFiles, Scenarios.
Requirements.REQ-003: `<Technology>` is Project-tier only; `<Contract>` is Module-tier only.
Requirements.REQ-004: Verification nodes parent exactly one verified architectural node of the matching tier and never another verification node.
Requirements.REQ-005: One statement carries one proposition, anchored at the highest applicable abstraction level; duplicate propositions across nodes or fields are forbidden.
Requirements.REQ-006: Every `<SCN-NNN>` carries a mandatory `target` attribute referencing a tested statement FQID; multiple scenarios may target one statement.
Requirements.REQ-007: Codemap is a symbolic projection only: code identifiers and relation operators, no natural-language prose; a parent's Codemap covers boundaries, interfaces, and inter-relations of all child siblings at its resolution level.
Requirements.REQ-008: Codemap authority is current source; key implementation symbols or architectural relations changed -> Codemap updated; file move/internal refactor with unchanged key symbols leaves Codemap unchanged.
Requirements.REQ-009: Contract conflicts with implementation: the contract wins unless intent is explicitly changed; material intent ambiguity is surfaced, never derived from implementation alone.
Requirements.REQ-010: `.frostline/graph/` (default, configurable) is the canonical catalog layout: architectural nodes (P/S/SS/M) and verification nodes (V-*) live side by side under `graph/`; the layout is convention, not semantic authority; membership is graph/declarations, not path location.
